name: review-run-metadataroot-false-stale
title: Thread metadataRoot through review-run snapshot + freshness so wrapper-root custom-storyDir metadata-only commits stop false-staling reviewer runs
description: review_run_start signs review-run material/story hashes (captureReviewRunSnapshot) and the consumer freshness checks (assertCurrentReviewRunForEvidence, validateEvidenceRunBinding) recompute them from signedWorkspaceRoot instead of the resolved metadataRoot. On a wrapper-root layout (metadataRoot != gitRoot) with a custom storyDir, story-metadata paths are wrongly folded into materialHash/storyFilesHash on both the production and consumer sides, so a metadata-only commit to that storyDir falsely flags the reviewer run stale and diverges from the DONE gate / quorum / validation hash semantics. Fix (two-sided, backward-compatible): (1) thread metadataRoot into captureReviewRunSnapshot + diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot and pass workspace.metadataRoot || ctx.root from the handler (default metadataRoot=projectRoot keeps plain repos byte-identical); (2) thread run.workspaceBinding?.metadataRoot ?? projectRoot into the two consumer freshness calls (binding already persists metadataRoot; legacy runs without a binding fall back to projectRoot). Reproduced red via a confirmed-failing probe (rp-mr1fmmur-clkpwd, red-reviewed target-bug) + spike.
